inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL scalar expression applies LN to a positive numeric value and to an EXP result.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one independent scalar projection containing LN(2) and LN(EXP(2)). It isolates the natural-log evaluator and nested exponential round trip without the source schema or surrounding examples.

fixture_notes: LN(2) is the positive natural logarithm and LN(EXP(2)) must return approximately 2.
determinism_notes: The scalar literals are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.

steps.sql: SELECT LN(2) AS natural_log, LN(EXP(2)) AS exp_log_round_trip
